01 / The challenge

The challenge for landscapers & gardeners.

Garden and landscaping businesses often run a van and a trailer, sometimes a pickup too. Your vehicles are parked in driveways for hours, so they are a perfect advert for the whole street.

01

Van plus trailer

Trailers are often parked separately and need their own branding.

02

Seasonal work

Customers book gardeners in spring. Your van needs to be memorable all year.

03

Mud and greenery

Vehicles get dirty fast, so bold designs work best.

02 / What to include

What your van must say.

  • Business name
  • Main services, e.g. landscaping, tree surgery
  • Phone number and website
  • Area covered, if you want to say it

Not sure what to include? Our guide to what to put on a work van walks you through it.

06 / Design tips

Build the layout around the job.

01

Brand the trailer too

A trailer parked in a driveway is a free advert. Give it your name and number.

02

Use nature carefully

One strong leaf or tree motif reads better than a busy garden photo.

03

Think about dirt

Darker greens and bold shapes hide dirt better than pale colours.

Before you book

Good to know.

Can you brand my trailer?

Yes. Send photos and dimensions and we will match it to your van.

Will printed foliage look good?

Yes, if it is a high-resolution image used boldly. We will advise on what reads best.

Can you brand a pickup with a canopy?

Yes. Send photos with the canopy fitted so we can plan around windows and hinges.
